name: FormField
description: Wrapper for a form field: label on top, the control (a TextField) in the middle, and below it a helper text or an error message with an icon. It ties label, control and message together so screen readers and people who make an error receive them together.

dos: Short label that says what is being asked: "Email address", not "Enter here".
Set `required` on mandatory fields. The asterisk is only a visual cue: the control must also carry the required attribute.
Use `error` only when the value is already incorrect, and state in the message what to fix: "Enter a valid email address".
Use `showHelper` to give a hint that helps fill in the field before making a mistake (format, example). Do not use it to repeat the label.

donts.case: Field without a visible label (placeholder only)
donts.why: The placeholder disappears when typing and reads poorly at low contrast. The label must stay visible.

donts.case: A control that is not a single-line text field (selection, checkbox, switch, multiple lines)
donts.useInstead: TextArea, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch (with their own label)
donts.why: FormField only accepts TextField as a control. The other controls carry their label inside and do not fit this anatomy.

donts.case: An error message with several sentences or a long paragraph
donts.why: The message sits next to the field and is read at a glance. A whole paragraph makes it unreadable.

donts.case: Signaling the error only with the red color of the border or text
donts.useInstead: error with the icon and the text message
donts.why: People with color blindness or using a screen reader do not perceive the color (WCAG 1.4.1). The message and the icon are the signal.

related.difference: FormField's control is a single-line TextField.
Multi-line field. Figma does not define it as a FormField control.
The error message icon is a size 14 Icon.

props.name: control
props.description: Field control. It is a slot: it only accepts TextField. In Figma it is an instance swap; its default value is a TextField with variant=surface, size=2 in placeholder state.

props.name: required
props.description: If true, shows the asterisk "*" next to the label in color error.11. The control must carry required (accessible), not just the asterisk.

props.name: showHelper
props.description: If true, shows the helper text below the control. Figma leaves it off by default.

props.name: error
props.description: If true, shows the icon and the error message below the control. In Figma it is the "error" value of the state property; the "default" value equals false.

controlled.name: error
controlled.description: The value is not valid. The control carries aria-invalid="true" and its description points to the error message. Shows the icon and the message.
controlled.aria: aria-invalid="true" on the control; aria-describedby points to the error message

root.description: Root element. Column with label, control and, if applicable, helper text or error.

label.description: Visible label, above the control. Associated with the control via htmlFor. The text is fixed "Etiqueta" in Figma: not a property.

requiredMark.description: Asterisk "*" next to the label, color colors.semantic.error.11. Only with required=true. Decorative: aria-hidden.

helper.description: Helper text below the control. Only with showHelper=true. The text is fixed "Texto de ayuda" in Figma. Has an id for aria-describedby.

error.description: Error message row: icon and text. Only with error=true. Has an id for aria-describedby.

errorIcon.description: 14 px "info" icon, to the left of the message. In Figma, in error state, its strokes carry the error.11 color.

errorMessage.description: Error message text. Color colors.semantic.error.11. The text is fixed "Mensaje de error" in Figma: not a property.

height.note: Sum of label (20 px), control (32 px), helper or error text (16 px) and two 8 px gaps. Without helper: 60 px. With error: 84 px.

modes.fill: Proposal: takes the container width. Figma has it fixed.

width.note: Figma defines a fixed 400 px. The control inside is full width (FILL).

autoLayout.gap: spacing.2 (8 px) between label, control and message.

labelLayout.gap: spacing.1 (4 px) between the text and the asterisk

errorLayout.gap: spacing.1 (4 px) between the icon and the message

a11y.role: No role of its own: the group is provided by the control (textbox) with its associated label.
a11y.name: The label (label) associated with the control via htmlFor. The asterisk is aria-hidden; the mandatory field is announced by the control with required.
a11y.focusIndicator: Inherited from TextField (the control's focus ring). FormField adds no ring of its own.
a11y.minTarget: The control (32 px tall) meets 24 × 24 px (WCAG 2.5.8). Label and message are not clickable targets.
a11y.contrastNote: Label with tokens.colors.text; error message with colors.semantic.error.11 on the background. ≥ 4.5:1 for normal text. Not measured in Figma.
wcag: 1.4.1 Use of Color (the error carries an icon and text)

label.voice: Short label for what is asked. The error message says what to fix. The fixed Figma text ("Etiqueta", "Texto de ayuda", "Mensaje de error") is sample only.

behavior.overflow: wrap: the helper and error text wrap onto several lines within the field width. Proposed decision: Figma does not define this case.

errorMessage.note: Fixed text "Mensaje de error" in Figma: not a property. Figma defines no validation rules.

form.note: FormField shows the state; it does not validate. Validation is done by whoever uses the field, who passes error=true.

i18n.rtl: The asterisk goes after the label in LTR. In RTL, decide whether it goes before. The error icon stays to the left of the message in LTR and moves to the right in RTL.
i18n.textExpansion: With text 30-40 % longer, the label grows in width and the message wraps. The height increases with each message line: the 84 px height is no longer fixed.

cases: renders a column with label, control and, if applicable, helper or error
the label is associated with the control via htmlFor
required=true shows the asterisk with colors.semantic.error.11 and aria-hidden; it does not replace the control's required attribute
showHelper=true shows the helper text; hidden by default
error=true shows the 14 px icon and the message; the control carries aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby pointing to the message
height 60 px without error or helper; 84 px with error
spacing.2 gaps between blocks and spacing.1 between text and icon / asterisk
the control accepts TextField and rejects other components in the slot

needsReview: Main question: the texts "Etiqueta", "Texto de ayuda" and "Mensaje de error" are fixed in Figma and have no property. The label, helperText and errorMessage props have not been added (AGENTS.md: do not add props that are not there). Without them, the component cannot show the real text. Decide: add the properties in Figma, or approve the props in code.

The control is an instance swap (control#35:6) whose default value is TextField variant=surface, size=2, state=placeholder, from the "✅ TextField" page of this same file. The swap's list of allowed options could not be read: allowedComponents stays as TextField.
TextField.contract.json points to another file (Radix-Themes, node 911:73249), not to the TextField in SD-Design-v2 (variant node 18:297). Check which is the TextField source before implementing.
The placeholder "nombre@correo.com" inside the control is an override of the TextField's placeholder property. FormField does not expose it as a prop: it is passed through the TextField itself.

Error state: the control does not change. input-container uses the same border (neutral-alpha.5 at 12 %) in default and error. Figma defines no error border for the control: decide whether one should exist (e.g. colors.semantic.error border) before implementing it.
Helper text and error message occupy the same position. Figma does not say what happens with error=true and showHelper=true. Proposed decision: the error message replaces the helper text.

Error icon: 14 px info Icon. In state=error its strokes carry colors.semantic.error.11 with a 1.17 px weight; in default, the icon does not have those strokes. The 14 px size has no token (Icon accepts size '14').
Width: the component set is 400 px FIXED. The contract proposes width default fill; the 400 px width is only the example's.
Measurements: 8 and 4 px gaps bound to spacing.2 and spacing.1. Height 60 / 84 px derived from the parts (no token). Line height of helper and error text: text-style.1.regular.
Overflow: helper and error text wrap. Figma does not define the case. Proposed decision.

Content, guidance, a11y (aria-invalid, aria-describedby, aria-hidden asterisk), testing, events and the form block: written as a draft. They do not come from Figma. Own decisions: error as a controlled state with aria, no internal validation and a visual-only asterisk.
Contrast not measured. Figma has no disabled or focus states in FormField.
governance: null, same as Button. Component owners still need to be defined.
